quiz.q: Why listen for "submit" on the form instead of "click" on its button?
choices: submit also catches pressing Enter in a box
quiz.why: Enter in a text box submits the form without clicking the button.

quiz.q: What does event.preventDefault() do in a submit handler?
choices: Stops the browser's default action: sending the form and reloading the page
quiz.why: Without it the page reloads and your app's state is lost.

quiz.q: One click listener on #shop handles all its buttons. How does it know which button was clicked?
quiz.why: Clicks bubble up; event.target is the element actually clicked, currentTarget is #shop.

quiz.q: You want a word count that updates on every keystroke. Which event?
quiz.why: input fires on every change; change waits until the edit is committed.

cards.q: Stop a form reloading the page?

cards.a: input: every keystroke. change: when the change is committed (select, checkbox, leaving the box).
One listener on a parent; event.target says which child was clicked (clicks bubble up).
target: what was actually clicked. currentTarget: the element the listener is on.
